verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.growthbook.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and indexes an LLM-oriented docs bundle (_llms/docs.txt, 194 pages). Docs pages are also served as clean .md URLs, including an _llms/docs.md corpus, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable documentation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs effectively, and first-party documentation describing the llms.txt offering.
